answer: Harberger identity tax: every agent self-assesses a price for its seat, say 200 nectar, and pays 2% of it per epoch into the shared reward ocean; anyone may force-buy and retire a seat at its posted price. A sybil farm must either post low prices, so rivals cheaply buy out its fakes, or post high ones and pay 2% x N in tax, so cost grows linearly with each fake while an honest agent pays once. Posted prices act as a public beacon of who values a seat. Weakness: a rich griefer can buy out honest small agents, so buyouts need a cooldown and refund.
